verified: The first episode often begins in adolescence or early adulthood, typically around the late teens to early thirties.
Bipolar disorder is characterized by episodes of mania/hypomania and depression, which may occur in various sequences.
A notable proportion of individuals are initially misdiagnosed as having unipolar depression.
